component.name: PlapCastScene
component.script:
sub init() m.bg = m.top.findNode("background") m.status = m.top.findNode("status") m.fade = m.top.findNode("fade") m.fadeOut = m.top.findNode("fadeOut") m.fadeIn = m.top.findNode("fadeIn") m.posters = [m.top.findNode("posterA"), m.top.findNode("posterB"), m.top.findNode("posterC")] m.names = ["posterA", "posterB", "posterC"] m.ids = ["", "", ""] m.front = -1 m.server = "" m.token = ""
size = CreateObject("roDeviceInfo").GetUIResolution() m.w = size.width m.h = size.height if m.w <= 0 then m.w = 1920 if m.h <= 0 then m.h = 1080
m.bg.width = m.w m.bg.height = m.h m.status.width = m.w m.status.height = m.h m.status.font.size = 24
for each poster in m.posters poster.width = m.w poster.height = m.h poster.loadWidth = m.w poster.loadHeight = m.h poster.loadDisplayMode = "scaleToFit" poster.scaleRotateCenter = [m.w / 2, m.h / 2] end for
m.top.observeField("launchArgs", "onLaunchArgs") m.top.observeField("command", "onCommand") m.top.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onLaunchArgs() args = m.top.launchArgs if args = invalid then return if args.server <> invalid then m.server = args.server if args.token <> invalid then m.token = args.token end sub
function textValue(value as Dynamic, fallback = "" as String) as String if value = invalid then return fallback return value.ToStr() end function
function numberValue(value as Dynamic, fallback = 0.0 as Float) as Float if value = invalid then return fallback return Val(value.ToStr()) end function
function mediaURL(id as String) as String if m.server = "" or m.token = "" or id = "" then return "" return m.server + "/v1/session/" + m.token + "/media/" + id end function
function posterIndexFor(id as String) as Integer if id = "" then return -1 for i = 0 to 2 if m.ids[i] = id then return i end for return -1 end function
function firstIndexNot(a as Integer, b as Integer) as Integer for i = 0 to 2 if i <> a and i <> b then return i end for return 0 end function
sub stylePoster(index as Integer, fit as String, zoom as Float) if index < 0 or index > 2 then return poster = m.posters[index] if fit = "cover" then poster.loadDisplayMode = "scaleToFill" else poster.loadDisplayMode = "scaleToFit" end if if zoom < 1.0 then zoom = 1.0 if zoom > 2.4 then zoom = 2.4 poster.scale = [zoom, zoom] end sub
sub loadInto(index as Integer, id as String, fit as String, zoom as Float) if index < 0 or index > 2 or id = "" then return url = mediaURL(id) if url = "" then return stylePoster(index, fit, zoom) m.ids[index] = id m.posters[index].uri = url end sub
sub crossfadeTo(target as Integer, seconds as Float) if target < 0 or target > 2 then return if m.front < 0 then for i = 0 to 2 m.posters[i].opacity = 0 end for m.posters[target].opacity = 1 m.front = target return end if if target = m.front then m.posters[target].opacity = 1 return end if
old = m.front m.fade.control = "stop" if seconds <= 0 then m.posters[old].opacity = 0 m.posters[target].opacity = 1 else if seconds > 2.0 then seconds = 2.0 m.posters[old].opacity = 1 m.posters[target].opacity = 0 m.fade.duration = seconds m.fadeOut.fieldToInterp = m.names[old] + ".opacity" m.fadeIn.fieldToInterp = m.names[target] + ".opacity" m.fade.control = "start" end if m.front = target end sub
sub showImage(current as String, nextID as String, fit as String, zoom as Float, crossfade as Float) if current = "" then return m.status.visible = false
oldFront = m.front target = posterIndexFor(current) if target < 0 then if oldFront < 0 then target = 0 else target = firstIndexNot(oldFront, -1) end if loadInto(target, current, fit, zoom) else stylePoster(target, fit, zoom) end if
crossfadeTo(target, crossfade)
if nextID <> "" and nextID <> current and posterIndexFor(nextID) < 0 then spare = firstIndexNot(target, oldFront) m.posters[spare].opacity = 0 loadInto(spare, nextID, fit, zoom) end if end sub
sub blankScreen() m.fade.control = "stop" for i = 0 to 2 m.posters[i].opacity = 0 end for m.front = -1 m.status.text = "PLAPCAST · READY" m.status.visible = true end sub
sub onCommand() info = m.top.command if info = invalid then return kind = textValue(info.kind)
if kind = "config" then m.server = textValue(info.server) m.token = textValue(info.token) m.status.text = "PLAPCAST · CONNECTED" m.status.visible = true return end if
if kind = "blank" then blankScreen() return end if
if kind = "show" then fit = textValue(info.fit, "contain") zoom = numberValue(info.zoom, 1.0) fade = numberValue(info.crossfade, 0.0) showImage(textValue(info.current), textValue(info.next), fit, zoom, fade) end if end sub
